name: How can I tell if a wall is load-bearing before I start a renovation?
description: Look for walls aligned with foundations or upper floors, but always get a professional assessment from Hometelligent Inc. before demolition.

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if a wall is load-bearing before I start a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if a wall is load-bearing often requires professional assessment. Key indicators include walls aligned with foundations, upper-story walls, central walls in a home, or walls with joists terminating on them. However, visual cues are not definitive. Before any demolition, Hometelligent Inc. recommends a professional inspection to confirm a wall's structural role and explore safe removal options.
